# coval_metric (Data Source)

Retrieves a Coval metric by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coval_metric" "resolution" {
  id = "abc123def456ghi789jklm"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Metric ID.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID that scopes this lookup. Omit it to use the organization's active default workspace.

### Read-Only

- `aggregation_method` (String) Aggregation method for custom trace or SQL float values.
- `base_prompt_template` (String) Composite prompt template.
- `categories` (Set of String) Classification categories.
- `create_time` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Creator email returned by Coval.
- `criteria` (Set of String) Composite literal criteria.
- `criteria_path` (String) Composite criteria path.
- `criteria_source` (String) Composite criteria source.
- `current_version` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--current_version))
- `description` (String) Metric description.
- `direction` (String) Threshold direction.
- `enabled_tools` (Set of String) Enabled Agent Judge evidence tools.
- `evaluation` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--evaluation))
- `expected_body` (Dynamic) Expected response body.
- `frequency_threshold` (Number) Audio frequency threshold.
- `include_traces` (Boolean) Whether trace context is included.
- `ivr_flow` (Dynamic) IVR flow JSON object.

- `max_silence_duration_seconds` (Number) Maximum silence duration.
- `max_value` (Number) Maximum score.
- `metadata_field_key` (String) Metadata field key.
- `metadata_field_type` (String) Metadata field type.
- `metric_name` (String) Human-readable metric name.
- `metric_type` (String) Metric evaluation type.
- `min_pause_duration_seconds` (Number) Minimum pause duration.

- `min_volume_change_for_pitch_misalignment` (Number) Minimum volume change for pitch misalignment.

- `operator` (String) Threshold comparison operator.
- `percent_above` (Number) Required percentage above threshold.
- `prompt` (String) LLM evaluation prompt.
- `regex_pattern` (String) Transcript regex pattern.
- `reporting_method` (String) Composite reporting method.
- `role` (String) Canonical speaker role.
- `runtime_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runtime_config))
- `sql_query` (String) SQL metric query.
